title: Chained Moon Sorceress
description: A dramatic surreal scene shows a pale-skinned figure with spiky blue hair floating in a contorted pose, wearing a flowing red and blue robe. The figure is bound by heavy metal chains connected to a large broken stone pathway that curves through the darkness, while a glowing moon with a hanging lantern and dripping liquid dominates the blood-red and purple sky above, surrounded by thorny vines and blue flowers.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene of a pale sorceress with spiky blue hair floating in a dramatic pose, wearing flowing red and blue robes, bound by heavy metal chains to a broken curving stone pathway. A large moon with a hanging lantern and dripping red liquid glows in a blood-red and purple sky, surrounded by thorny black vines and glowing blue flowers, dramatic lighting, dripping paint effects, occult atmosphere.
